cloud.title: Glowrium cloud account
cloud.description: Sign in for account-linked remote control. A separately added Bluetooth light with the same hardware MAC shares these entities.

local_confirm.title: Add {name}
local_confirm.description: Model: {model}, hardware MAC: {mac}. Confirm this is your light. Local BLE may lack authentication; nearby clients may also be able to control it. If the glowrium App is connected, disconnect it before continuing. Adding this light does not bind, activate or reset it in the cloud.

data.confirm: I recognize this light and want to enable local control

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Glowrium
reauth_confirm.description: Your cloud session expired. Sign in with the same account. Independently added Bluetooth lights continue to work.

error.confirmation_required: Confirm the selected light before connecting
error.cannot_connect_bluetooth: Unable to read the light over Bluetooth. Check range and disconnect the manufacturer app.
